an8.26:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati jīvakambavane.
an8.26:1.2: athakho jīvako komārabhacco yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho jīvako komārabhacco bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an8.26:1.3: kittāvatā nu kho bhante upāsako hotīti.
an8.26:1.4: yato kho jīvaka buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti
an8.26:2.1: kittāvatā pana bhante upāsako sīlavā hotīti.
an8.26:2.2: yato kho jīvaka upāsako pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti …pe… surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti
an8.26:2.3: ettāvatā kho jīvaka upāsako sīlavā hotīti.
an8.26:3.1: kittāvatā pana bhante upāsako attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāyāti.
an8.26:3.2: yato kho jīvaka upāsako attanā ca saddhāsampanno hoti no paraṃ saddhāsampadāya samādapeti …pe…
an8.26:3.3: attanā ca atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti no paraṃ dhammānudhammapaṭipattiyā samādapeti
an8.26:3.4: ettāvatā kho jīvaka upāsako attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāyāti.
an8.26:4.1: kittāvatā pana bhante upāsako attahitāya ca paṭipanno hoti parahitāya cāti.
an8.26:4.2: yato kho jīvaka upāsako attanā ca saddhāsampanno hoti parañca saddhāsampadāya samādapeti
an8.26:4.3: attanā ca sīlasampanno hoti parañca sīlasampadāya samādapeti
an8.26:4.4: attanā ca cāgasampanno hoti parañca cāgasampadāya samādapeti
an8.26:4.5: attanā ca bhikkhūnaṃ dassanakāmo hoti parañca bhikkhūnaṃ dassane samādapeti
an8.26:4.6: attanā ca saddhammaṃ sotukāmo hoti parañca saddhammassavane samādapeti
an8.26:4.7: attanā ca sutānaṃ dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti parañca dhammadhāraṇāya samādapeti
an8.26:4.8: attanā ca sutānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthupaparikkhī hoti parañca atthupaparikkhāya samādapeti
an8.26:4.9: attanā ca atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti parañca dhammānudhammapaṭipattiyā samādapeti
an8.26:4.10: ettāvatā kho jīvaka upāsako attahitāya ca paṭipanno hoti parahitāya cāti. 27
